race.description: Inland Truck Centres Pty Ltd Mdn Plate
race.comment: THE MAJOR (4) is yet to break through after four career starts. Managed to find the placings at Wagga two starts back before finishing eighth over 1180m at Gundagai last start. Well placed this line-up and might be his day. SHEZRUSHIN (7) could only manage sixth two runs back then improved last start but found a couple better over 1100m at Gundagai, beaten only half a length. Tackling a more suitable race so she is sure to prove hard to beat. EYES RIGHT (9) pushed forward from a wide draw last time out and was prominent for a long way before fading to finish fourth over 1400m at Gundagai. Sure to give a sight. RELAX THE SPIRIT (12) was far below scratch last time but had shown some glimpses prior. Keeping a minor spot open for her.
